# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide requirements in `AGENTS.md`. Before proposing code, consult
`docs/project-map/index.mdx` and the relevant ADR. Preserve the shared audio-core contract, Vue 3
legacy API compatibility, capability-based fallback and all release gates. Stable publication needs
either complete device evidence or the explicit version-bound maintainer assessment recorded in
`docs/device-smoke.md`; never infer a waiver.
